# Vendored ResizeRight

Source: https://github.com/assafshocher/ResizeRight

Retrieved through the GitHub connector on 2026-11-08. The latest commit affecting `resize_right.py` at retrieval was `6b1c962f3fe5972205b78a9a293a57a7139d41e7`. Python source is unchanged apart from trailing newline handling during storage. The original MIT license is in `LICENSE`.

```text

857bac31b968712d35dffab9223e8a6e77f2a6d4a38b63befdb325e6937ddd33  interp_methods.py
7579cbbeefc942a7486fbcd39149a6352e1a1bcdbe8d9eae77d22511ed496710  LICENSE
```

The enclosing bridge chooses symmetric padding explicitly. Upstream's default is constant zero padding. Native nearest-neighbor point sampling and upstream's box interpolation are distinct methods.
